author: claude
body: Done, in your words, on the page (blog e5823f6b) and in the LinkedIn draft (hub e4411a2): "Had I known about this setting, I could have saved about 10% ... and nearly 50% in one of them." I changed two things. First, it says one session, not some: only one reached 45 to 50%, and the next best was 30 to 35%. Second, the 10% covers the 96 work sessions that ran on the 5-minute cache, about a quarter of my work spend, not every API dollar. The page already says that, and the post says "those sessions".
